sources.entry: Orchestrator - macOS workspace for Codex with repository browsing, Kanban tasks, subagent inspection and local code review.

summary.one_liner: Orchestrator is a free, open-source macOS app that combines repository browsing, Codex conversations, Kanban task boards, subagent inspection and local code review for a workspace.
summary.what_it_does: It lets you add local workspaces and browse their files with syntax highlighting beside a Codex chat. A Kanban board turns ideas into cards that move from preparation through execution and review, with a target branch selectable for new card branches and pull requests. Subagent tasks can be inspected for their original instruction, conversation and activity without losing the parent chat. Changed files can be browsed, diffed, and approved or sent back before publishing, including per-repository review for multi-repository workspaces. It also shows local run activity and token totals by workspace and date range. The README additionally describes publishing draft GitHub or GitLab review requests when cards finish, with a local-review fallback.
use_cases: review AI agent code changes before publishing
track coding-agent tasks on a Kanban board
inspect subagent work from a parent chat
browse repository files alongside a Codex conversation
publish draft GitHub or GitLab merge requests from finished tasks
how_to_run: Download Orchestrator_aarch64.dmg (Apple Silicon) or Orchestrator_x86_64.dmg (Intel) from Releases
Drag Orchestrator into Applications and open it
Sign in with your own supported Codex account and add a workspace
To build from source: git clone the repository, cd orchestrator, npm ci
notable: Combines a Codex chat, file browser, Kanban board and code review in one Mac app
Subagent inspection shows each delegated task's instruction, conversation and activity
Supports GitHub and GitLab connections, including self-managed GitLab hosts, with local review as fallback
Keychain-stored GitLab credentials and signed in-app updates
caveats: Experimental community beta (0.2.0-beta.3); ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple, so macOS may block first launch
Requires macOS 15 or later and your own supported Codex account for AI tasks
Browser, Computer Use and plugin integrations are experimental and may need separately installed upstream components
